create_album.description: This works on your own Waifu.im account, so it needs an API key on the connection. Browsing the archive needs none. Make a new album on the account. Pair it with 'Add an image to an album' to have a workflow build a collection of its own: a week's picks, everything matching a tag, whatever somebody reacted to in chat.

Use it to turn a collection into a post, a slideshow or a digest without having to list the album and then fetch its contents separately.

get_my_profile.description: This works on your own Waifu.im account, so it needs an API key on the connection. Browsing the archive needs none. Read the Waifu.im account the connected key belongs to: its id, display name and role. Mostly useful as a check that the key works and is pointing at the account you meant, and for the user id the album actions are addressed by.
get_my_profile.name: get_my_profile

get_random_image.description: Pull one anime illustration at random out of Waifu.im's archive, narrowed by tag, shape or size. The usual way to use it: a daily post, a random header, a bit of decoration in a digest. Safe images only unless you change the adult setting, which is how the API behaves too. The response carries the artist credits and the original source, which is what an attribution line needs.

get_random_image.name: get_random_image

report_image.description: This works on your own Waifu.im account, so it needs an API key on the connection. Browsing the archive needs none. Report an image to the Waifu.im moderators. The archive is contributed by its users and its operators host rather than vet every upload, so this is the route for anything that should not be there: a picture tagged wrongly, a copyright complaint from the artist, or something worse. Worth wiring up if a workflow puts these images in front of other people.

description: Pull anime artwork into a workflow from Waifu.im, an archive of around 4,300 illustrations tagged by character, series and theme. Get a random image for a daily post or a header, search the archive by tag, shape and pixel size, and read the artist credits and original source that an attribution line needs. Browsing needs no account. Adding an API key also lets a workflow keep albums of its own and report an image to the moderators. Most of this archive is adult material, so every action defaults to safe images only, as the API itself does, and returning adult content is a setting you have to turn on deliberately.
